blocks.prompt:
1 Define pharmacology and drugs. Describe the sources of drugs and the aim of drug discovery and development. (4 marks)
(Pharmacology aur drugs ki definition likhein. Dawaon ke zariye aur drug discovery aur development ka maqsad bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pharmacology: biology ki woh shakh jo dawaon aur zinda organisms par un ke asraat ka mutaala karti hai. Is mein dawaon ke zariye, khasiyat, banawat, ilaji istemal aur jism par asraat shamil hain.
Drugs: kimiyai mawad jo bimariyon ki tashkhees, bachao ya ilaj ke liye istemal hote hain.

Dawaon ke zariye:
1. Qudrati: paude, janwar aur microorganisms. Paudon se bani dawaiyan riwayati ilaj mein istemal hoti hain aur herbal medicines ya phytotherapy kehlati hain.
2. Masnooi: laboratory mein banai gayi dawaiyan.

Drug discovery aur development ka maqsad: mehfooz aur mufeed dawaiyan banana. Amal bimari paida karne wale targets pehchanne aur un se amal karne wale compounds banane se shuru hota hai. Awam ke liye manzoori se pehle dawa ki safety, efficacy aur quality kayi marahil mein test hoti hai; scientists, researchers aur regulatory idare mil kar yaqeeni banate hain ke nayi dawaiyan faidemand aur mehfooz hon.

book_ref.quote: Drug discovery and drug development are important processes

blocks.prompt:
2 Compare drug discovery with drug development, naming the stages of each. (4 marks)
(Drug discovery ka drug development se muwazna karein aur dono ke marahil ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Drug discovery nayi dawa dhoondti hai; drug development use test kar ke awam ke liye tayyar karti hai.

book_ref.quote: There are following stages to develop a new drug

rows: Kisi bimari ke liye nayi dawa dhoondne ka ibtidai marhala
Daryaft shuda dawa ko test kar ke awam ke liye tayyar karne ka amal
1. Target identification: bimari paida karne wala molecule (protein ya enzyme) pehchana jata hai
1. Preclinical research: in vitro (cell culture) aur in vivo (janwar) mein safety, toxicity aur efficacy ke test
2. Target validation: bimari mein us ka kirdar tasdeeq hota hai
2. Clinical trials: insanon par Phase 1, 2 aur 3
3. Lead compound identification: hazaron compounds ki screening
3. FDA drug review: idare (FDA ya EMA) dawa manzoor ya rad karte hain
4. Lead optimization: lead compounds ko asar barhane aur zehreelapan kam karne ke liye badla jata hai
4. Manufacturing aur marketing, phir 5. Post-marketing surveillance

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain the three phases of clinical trials, giving the size of the group tested and the purpose of each phase. (4 marks)
(Clinical trials ke teen phases ki wazahat karein, har phase mein test hone wale group ka size aur maqsad batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Clinical trials mein dawaiyan insanon par safety yaqeeni banane ke liye test hoti hain, cell cultures aur janwaron ke preclinical tests ke baad.

1. Phase 1: 20-100 sehatmand razakaron ke chhote group par dawa ki safety aur dose maloom karne ke liye testing.
2. Phase 2: 100-300 mareezon ke bare group par dawa ka asar aur side effects jaanchne ke liye testing.
3. Phase 3: 1,000-3,000 mareezon par bare paimane ke trials taa ke efficacy ki tasdeeq ho aur muzir asraat ki nigrani ho.

Trials ke baad regulatory idare (FDA ya EMA) saara data jaanch kar dawa manzoor ya rad karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Phase 3: Large-scale trials (1,000–3,000) are taken to confirm the efficacy

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe what happens to a new drug after its clinical trials until it is in use by the population. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke clinical trials ke baad nayi dawa ke saath awam ke istemal tak kya hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
1. FDA drug review: regulatory idare (FDA ya EMA) clinical trials ka saara data bariki se jaanch kar dawa ko market mein bhejne se pehle manzoor ya rad karte hain.

2. Manufacturing aur marketing: manzoori ke baad dawa pharmaceutical industries mein bare paimane par banti hai aur ilaj ke liye muhayya hoti hai.

3. Post-marketing surveillance: market mein aane ke baad bhi dawa ki lambe arse ke asraat aur kam paye jane wale side effects ke liye musalsal nigrani hoti hai, taa ke aabadi mein us ki hifazat barqarar rahe.

book_ref.quote: Even after release, the drug is continuously monitored

blocks.prompt:
5 Antibiotics either kill bacteria or stop their growth. Explain bactericidal and bacteriostatic action with examples from the classes of antibiotic. (4 marks)
(Antibiotics ya to bacteria ko maarti hain ya un ki barhotri rokti hain. Antibiotics ki qismon se misalein de kar bactericidal aur bacteriostatic amal ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Antibiotics bacteria ko maar kar ya un ki barhotri rok kar ilaj karti hain; in ki darja bandi amal ke tareeqe aur kimiyai banawat par hai.

Bactericidal antibiotics bacteria ko maarti hain:
1. Penicillin peptidoglycan (murein) chains ki cross-linking rokti hai, cell wall ki mazbooti khatam hoti hai aur cell phat jata hai (lysis).
2. Fluoroquinolones DNA replication ke enzymes (Type II topoisomerases) ko phansa kar DNA ki dono strands torti hain, bacteria barh nahin pate aur mar jate hain.

Bacteriostatic antibiotics bacteria ko maare baghair un ka barhna rokti hain:
1. Tetracycline 30S ribosomal subunit se jur kar aminoacyl-tRNA ko acceptor site par jurne nahin deti, is liye protein nahin banti.
2. Sulfonamides bacteria mein folic acid ka banna rokti hain, barhotri ruk jati hai aur jism ka immune system bacteria ko khatam karta hai. Trimethoprim ke saath mil kar inka asar bactericidal ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Antibiotics are drugs that treat bacterial infection by killing bacteria or stopping their growth

blocks.prompt:
6 Compare penicillin with tetracycline. (4 marks)
(Penicillin ka tetracycline se muwazna karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono antibiotics hain magar zariye, amal aur asraat mein mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: Penicillin is a group of bactericidal, antibiotics derived from Penicillium fungi

rows: Penicillium fungi se; Alexander Fleming ne daryaft ki (1928)
Mitti mein rehne wale Streptomyces genus ke bacteria se
Bactericidal: lysis se bacteria ko maarti hai
Bacteriostatic: bacteria ka barhna aur taadad barhana rokti hai
Peptidoglycan chains ki cross-linking rok kar cell wall banna band karti hai
30S ribosomal subunit se jur kar protein banna rokti hai
Gram-positive bacteria (streptococcal, staphylococcal infections) par bohat asar
Gram-positive aur Gram-negative dono par asar (maslan chlamydia, syphilis)
Side effects: matli, ulti, dast, pet dard, jild par daane
Side effects: matli, ulti, dast, dhoop se hassasiyat; doodh ya iron ke saath nahin

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the origin of fluoroquinolones and explain how they kill bacteria. (4 marks)
(Fluoroquinolones ki ibtida bayan karein aur wazahat karein ke yeh bacteria ko kaise maarti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Ibtida: fluoroquinolones masnooi antibacterial mawad hain jo chloroquine ki tayyari ke byproduct ke tor par mile. Chloroquine quinine ki banawat badal kar bani masnooi dawa hai; quinine South American Cinchona darakht ki chhaal ka qudrati alkaloid hai. Yeh bactericidal antibiotics hain jo bacteria ki DNA replication rok kar ilaj karti hain.

Amal ka tareeqa:
1. Topoisomerases ko nishana: fluoroquinolones bacterial cells mein ja kar Type II topoisomerases ko rokti hain.
2. Topoisomerase IV: Gram-positive bacteria mein bunyadi nishana; is ke rukne se replicate hui DNA ka alag hona band hota hai.
3. DNA gyrase: Gram-negative bacteria mein bunyadi nishana; is ke rukne se replication mein DNA ka khulna band hota hai.
4. Bactericidal asar: dawa in enzymes ko aise complex mein phansati hai jis se DNA ki dono strands toot jati hain, bacteria barh nahin pate aur mar jate hain.

Side effects (kam magar sangeen): tendon ka phatna, peripheral neuropathy, drug resistance aur dil ke masail.

book_ref.quote: are a class of bactericidal antibiotics that treat bacterial infections by inhibiting bacterial DNA replication

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain how sulfonamides act on bacteria without harming human cells, and why they are combined with trimethoprim. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke sulfonamides insani cells ko nuqsan diye baghair bacteria par kaise asar karti hain, aur inhein trimethoprim ke saath kyun milaya jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Sulfonamides sulfanilamide se bane masnooi compounds hain (Gerhard Domagk, 1932).

1. Competitive inhibition: sulfonamides folate banane wale enzyme se jur kar folate metabolism ka para-aminobenzoic acid raasta band karti hain. Yeh bacteria mein folic acid ka banna rokti hain jo DNA banne aur barhotri ke liye zaroori hai.
2. Selective toxicity: bacteria ko folate khud shuru se banana parta hai, jab ke insaan use khurak se jazb karte hain. Is liye dawa bacteria ko zaroori ghiza se mehroom karti hai aur insani cells mehfooz rehte hain.
3. Bacteriostatic asar: yeh bacteria ko foran nahin maarti balke barhotri rokti hain, phir jism ka immune system unhein khatam karta hai.
4. Combined therapy: aksar trimethoprim jaise mawad ke saath milai jati hain taa ke zyada mazboot bactericidal asar ho.
Yeh broad spectrum hain (Gram-positive aur Gram-negative) aur peshab ki naali, acne aur saans ke infections mein istemal hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Sulfonamides are selectively toxic to bacteria because of how they handle folate

blocks.prompt:
9 Give the source or discoverer and the common side effects of each of the four major classes of antibiotic. (4 marks)
(Antibiotics ki chaar bari qismon mein se har aik ka zariya ya daryaft karne wala aur aam side effects likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Penicillin: Penicillium fungi se; Alexander Fleming ne daryaft ki (1928). Side effects: matli, ulti, dast, pet dard aur jild par daane.

2. Tetracycline: mitti mein rehne wale Streptomyces genus ke bacteria se. Side effects: matli, ulti, dast aur dhoop se hassasiyat; doodh ki cheezon ya iron supplements ke saath na li jaye.

3. Fluoroquinolones: masnooi, chloroquine (quinine) ki tayyari ka byproduct. Kam magar sangeen side effects: tendon ka phatna, peripheral neuropathy, drug resistance aur dil ke masail.

4. Sulfonamides: sulfanilamide se bane masnooi compounds, Gerhard Domagk ne daryaft kiye (1932). Side effects: jild par daane, matli, roshni se hassasiyat aur gurde ka nuqsan.

book_ref.quote: Antibiotics are classified primarily by their mechanism of action and chemical structure

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe antiviral and antiretroviral drugs. Explain why all antiretroviral drugs are antiviral but not all antiviral drugs are antiretroviral. (4 marks)
(Antiviral aur antiretroviral dawaiyan bayan karein. Wazahat karein ke tamam antiretroviral dawaiyan antiviral kyun hain magar tamam antiviral antiretroviral kyun nahin.)
blocks.explanation:
Antiviral dawaiyan: viral infections ke ilaj ke liye. Yeh jism mein viruses ka barhna aur taadad barhana rokti hain aur hepatitis, influenza aur herpes jaise bohat se viruses ke khilaf kaam karti hain.

Antiretroviral dawaiyan: retroviruses, jaise HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus), se hone wali bimariyon ke ilaj ke liye. Yeh immune system ke difa mein madad deti hain aur HIV ko barhne se rokti hain. Retroviruses ka genetic material RNA hai aur yeh enzyme reverse transcriptase se copies banate hain.

Wazahat: retroviruses viruses ki aik qisam hain, is liye retroviruses ke khilaf dawa virus ke khilaf dawa (antiviral) bhi hai. Magar antiviral dawaiyan bohat se aise viruses par bhi kaam karti hain jo retroviruses nahin, maslan hepatitis, influenza aur herpes, is liye har antiviral dawa antiretroviral nahin.

book_ref.quote: They aid in immune system defense and stop HIV from proliferating

blocks.prompt:
11 What are monoclonal antibodies? Explain their role in personalized medicine and how new technologies speed up their development. (4 marks)
(Monoclonal antibodies kya hain? Personalized medicine mein in ka kirdar aur nayi technologies in ki tayyari kaise tez karti hain, wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Monoclonal antibodies: laboratory mein bane masnooi molecules jo immune system ki pathogens se larne ki salahiyat barhate hain. Yeh khaas antigens ko nishana banati hain, is liye cancer, autoimmune bimariyon aur infectious bimariyon ke ilaj mein mufeed hain.

Personalized medicine mein kirdar: yeh personalized medicine ka lazmi hissa hain aur har mareez ke profile ke mutabiq ilaj mumkin banati hain. In ki design aur tayyari mein musalsal jiddat ilaj ka asar barhane ke liye zaroori hai, taa ke yeh har mareez ki apni biology ke zyada munasib hon.

Tez tayyari: jadeed technologies hazaron mumkina antibodies ko aik saath test karti hain. Is se tayyari ka waqt kam hota hai aur infectious bimariyon aur cancer jaise fori masail ka jald jawab mumkin hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Continued innovation in these antibodies in design and production is critical
